findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, dynamoi_create_smart_links_from_spotify_artist, dynamoi_list_smart_links, dynamoi_get_smart_link · Private data: dynamoi_list_artists, dynamoi_search, fetch, dynamoi_apply_for_distribution · Public sink: dynamoi_get_youtube_channel_data, dynamoi_apply_for_distribution, dynamoi_preview_smart_link_themes, dynamoi_list_smart_links, dynamoi_update_smart_link_description, dynamoi_update_smart_link_artist_settings · Destructive: dynamoi_get_campaign, dynamoi_get_artist_analytics, dynamoi_get_youtube_channel_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, dynamoi_create_smart_links_from_spotify_artist, dynamoi_list_smart_links, dynamoi_get_smart_link · Private data: dynamoi_list_artists, dynamoi_search, fetch, dynamoi_apply_for_distribution · Public sink: dynamoi_get_youtube_channel_data, dynamoi_apply_for_distribution, dynamoi_preview_smart_link_themes, dynamoi_list_smart_links, dynamoi_update_smart_link_description, dynamoi_update_smart_link_artist_settings · Destructive: dynamoi_get_campaign, dynamoi_get_artist_analytics, dynamoi_get_youtube_channel_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
